analytics.name: Name
analytics.allocationNote: Item values = observed unit price × quantity. Values with multiple tags are split equally. Receipt-level differences are not allocated.
analytics.frequencyComparison: Comparison of consecutive periods with equal duration
analytics.noComparison: No complete coverage for the comparison period.
analytics.unitsScope: Only receipts containing known piece/pack units exclusively. Mixed quantities are not comparable.
analytics.promotionShare: Share of purchases with a promotion
analytics.promotionProducts: Products with the most promotional lines
analytics.promotionNote: Promotion IDs identify offers but do not establish a specific saving.
analytics.historicalNote: Historical observations, not guaranteed current selling prices. Comparisons require the same verified product/pack identity and quantity unit.
analytics.stability: Price stability by product and branch
analytics.stabilityNote: Population standard deviation / average × 100. At least three observations; lower values indicate more stable prices.
analytics.rankingsNote: Changes compare first and last observations in the period, within the same branch and product identity.
analytics.truncated: The history is limited. Narrow the period for more detail.
analytics.quantityNote: Compare quantities only within the same unit. Pieces/packs are not standardized weights. Unknown units are excluded from quantity rankings.
analytics.selectUnit: Select a known unit for the quantity ranking.
analytics.tagNote: Tag purchase counts refer to distinct receipts and are not additive; item values are split between multiple tags.
analytics.paretoNote: A: share before product < 80%, B: < 95%, C: remaining. Classification covers all filtered products before pagination.
analytics.recentLimit: The latest {{count}} receipt lines in the selected period.
analytics.historicalDifferencesNote: Comparisons use last observed prices for identical products across branches. Observation dates may differ. Not a guaranteed saving or a current offer.
analytics.noMerchantRanking: Average purchase values describe baskets, not a store's general price level.

help.label: About the data
help.title: About the data
help.body: Metrics cover all imported purchases. The period filter only affects the chart and monthly overview. The API sums TaxBaseAmount as expenses and TaxAmount as taxes; no net/gross interpretation is applied. The weekly value shows the growth in the cumulative total from receipts in the last seven days, not a week-over-week comparison. Missing values are shown as “—”.
